name: Perforated Tray Mounting Bracket
description: Engineering drawing of a single-solid perforated tray mounting bracket: a flat rectangular base with upright front and rear walls carrying rows of vertical capsule vents, a low right edge, two raised rear mounting ears with horizontal slots, an inward rear shelf, two front mounting tabs with holes, two interior risers with drilled platforms, and an octagonal through opening in the base. Top, front, rear and side views plus an isometric view specify the part. Dimensions are in millimetres.
